args.body: Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. Based on the text I could access, it clearly identifies the site as yours and makes your email easy to find. I'd suggest adding a short introduction about yourself and what visitors can expect, plus a few examples of your work or interests to make the site more personal and informative. I could only review the accessible text, so I can't comment on the visual design.

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. Based on the text I could access, mentioning your love of hiking gives the blog a nice personal touch. I'd suggest adding an introduction explaining what you'll write about and sharing hiking stories, favorite trails, or practical tips to give visitors more to explore. I could only review the accessible text, so I can't comment on the visual design.

final_text:
Visited both websites, invited Dora to Slack, and sent each of them feedback:

- **Dora:** Suggested adding a personal introduction and examples of her work or interests, while noting that her contact email is easy to find.
- **Eve:** Suggested expanding on her hiking interest with stories, favorite trails, and practical tips.

I based the feedback on the accessible text, not the sites’ visual design.
